name: nv_consultation_decide_v1
description: For this private consultation only: accept the caller, decline, reply with a message for the caller, or ask one clarification question. A phone answer is not consent. Do not accept on behalf of voicemail or another person. Never specify another destination.

name: nv_consultation_answer_v1
description: Submit the caller’s concise answer to the current colleague clarification question. Available only after the backend requested one clarification; does not authorize a transfer.
